verdict.rationale: A test or sandbox mode that keeps an agent away from production data is a fair question for a cloud browser-agent API, so this axis applies. The evidence pack documents no sandbox or test environment, test API keys, or data-isolation mode. Hardened cloud browsers, saved profiles, free signup credits and the local open-source library are adjacent features or user-side arrangements, not a documented sandbox capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
